events.title: Northern Ag Expo
events.usual: Usually late Nov or early Dec · 2 days
events.note: Big winter farm show — equipment, seed, grain handling and dryer dealers. Good place to collect quotes for the dryer, pit & leg project.

events.title: Prairie Grains Conference
events.note: Wheat and barley talks plus a trade show.

events.title: Northern Corn & Soybean Expo
events.note: Free expo — corn and soybean education, exhibitors and networking.

events.title: Big Iron Farm Show
events.town: Red River Valley Fairgrounds, West Fargo, ND
events.note: One of the biggest outdoor farm shows in the region — field demos and new iron.
